review_scope: Maintainer review for A012 reply handling, tone, actual request preservation. Not a global model quality evaluation.

live_01.automatic_checks: 12/12 passed older routing-only assertions; insufficient for acceptance.

failures.issue: Invented motive and incorrect repeated opening: 偷懒; 连着两次都从你好起头.
Ignored explicit one-sentence request and appended example/explanation.

findings: Greeting/how-are-you replies differ; feedback is short and does not blame the user or invent internal causes.
Mixed RAG request was answered concisely; quoted feedback entered ordinary answer, not response-only handling.
Quoted phrase answers still contain overgeneralized language about the phrase and evaluation intent. Routing passes; this is not a claim that all linguistic content is correct.

observed_replies: 抱歉，刚才回得太干巴了。

limitations: One repeat of a small synthetic set; no confidence threshold or daily Jev activation recommendation.
Generated-reply filter handles observed invalid sentences; it is not a complete semantic safety or language-quality check.
Final naturalness acceptance remains with Rex.
